headline: Mercado Bitcoin reports ongoing security breach following initial hack
summary: A security breach at Mercado Bitcoin persisted after the exchange claimed the attack was contained. The attacker reportedly stole approximately $391,000, with links identified to a separate hack at BitMart.
why: Security breaches at cryptocurrency exchanges highlight systemic risks in digital asset custody and the vulnerability of centralized platforms to cyberattacks.

impacts.name: Mercado Bitcoin
impacts.why: Security incidents typically damage investor confidence and platform reputation.
